questions.question: Amir distributes 800 gifts to 4 children. The first child receives a certain number of gifts. The second child receives twice that amount, the third child receives three times that amount, and the fourth child receives four times that amount. How many gifts are available to both the first and the second?
questions.solution:
Concept:

Let the number of gifts received by the first child be x. Then, the number of gifts received by the second child is 2x, by the third child is 3x, and by the fourth child is 4x.

Formula Used:

Total gifts distributed = x + 2x + 3x + 4x = 800

Calculation:

⇒ x + 2x + 3x + 4x = 800

⇒ 10x = 800

⇒ x = 800 / 10

⇒ x = 80

Now,

First and second child received the gifts:

⇒ x + 2x = 3x

⇒ 3 × 80

⇒ 240

∴ The correct answer is option (2).

questions.question: A man moving with a speed of 20kmph to cover a distance from his house to his office is late by 10 min. If he moves with a speed of 25kmph, he reaches his office 5 minutes earlier. Find the distance between the house and the office?
questions.solution:
Concept used:

Distance/speed = Time 

Relative time is taken by man = (t1 + t2)

Solution: 

According to the information given in the question

Let the distance = D km.

If a man travels at a speed of 20kmph 

The time taken by man = (D/20)

If a man travels at a speed of 25kmph

Time taken by man = (D/25)

Relative time taken by the man = (10 + 5 ) = 15min.

Calculation:

(D/20) - (D/25) = 15/60

(5D - 4D)/100 = 1/4

D/100 = 1/4

D = 25km

Hence the distance between the office and the home is 25kms.

questions.question: The ratio of the present age for A and B is 3 : 4. 10 years ago, the ratio of their age is 2 : 3. After 'x' years from today, the age of A will become (9)/(10) times the age of B. Find the value of x.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the present age for A and B is 3 : 4. 

10 years ago, the ratio of their age is 2 : 3.

After 'x' years from today, the age of A will become (9)/(10) times the age of B. 

**Calculation:**

At present:

The present age of A = 3x

The present age of B = 4x

10 years ago:

⇒ (3x-10)/(4x - 10) = (2)/(3) 

⇒ 9x - 30 = 8x - 20

⇒ x = 10

The present age of A = 3 × 10 = 30 years

The present age of B = 4 × 10 = 40 years

After 'x' years from today:

The age of A = (9)/(10) of B

According to the question,

⇒ (30+x)/(40+x)=(9)/(10)

⇒ 10 × (30 + x) = 9 × (40 + x)

⇒ 300 + 10x = 360 + 9x

⇒ x = 60 years.

∴ After 60 years from today the age of A will become (9)/(10) times of the age of B.

questions.question: If each interior angle of a regular polygon is 144°, then the number of its sides is:
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ किसी **नियमित बहुभुज (regular polygon)** के लिए, उसके **आंतरिक कोण (interior angle)** और **बाह्य कोण (exterior angle)** का योग हमेशा 180° होता है। ⇒ बाह्य कोण = 180° − आंतरिक कोण = 180° − 144° = 36° किसी भी नियमित बहुभुज की **भुजाओं की संख्या (n)** = 360° ÷ बाह्य कोण ⇒ n = 360° ÷ 36° = 10 **∴ The correct answer is 10.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **दिया गया है:** एक **नियमित बहुभुज** का प्रत्येक आंतरिक कोण = 144° **उपयोग किया गया सूत्र:** एक नियमित बहुभुज (n भुजाओं वाले) का प्रत्येक आंतरिक कोण = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65e524009e041d5e00f70d08888a4f7532aff518a565a6eecaffb3d32a70c704.png] **गणना:** ⇒ 144° = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n ⇒ 144n = 180n − 360 ⇒ 360 = 180n − 144n ⇒ 360 = 36n ⇒ n = 360 ÷ 36 ⇒ n = 10 **∴ The correct answer is 10.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** बहुभुज के आंतरिक कोणों का योग किसी भी n-भुजाओं वाले बहुभुज के सभी आंतरिक कोणों का योग (n − 2) × 180° होता है। बाह्य कोणों का योग किसी भी उत्तल बहुभुज (convex polygon) के सभी बाह्य कोणों का योग हमेशा 360° होता है। नियमित बहुभुज का बाह्य कोण एक नियमित बहुभुज का प्रत्येक बाह्य कोण 360° ÷ n के बराबर होता है। a0:Tdd1, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ किसी **समबहुभुज** के लिए, उसके **अंतःकोण** और **बहिष्कोण** का योग सदैव 180° होता है। ⇒ बहिष्कोण = 180° − अंतःकोण = 180° − 144° = 36° किसी भी समबहुभुज की **भुजाओं की संख्या (n)** = 360° ÷ बहिष्कोण ⇒ n = 360° ÷ 36° = 10 **∴ सही उत्तर 10 है।**

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks up the price of the oil by 40% and uses a faulty machine which measures 15% less. If the shopkeeper gives a discount of 32%, the profit/loss percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Markup percentage = 40%

Faulty machine measures 15% less

Discount given = 32%

**Formula Used:**

Profit/Loss percentage = (frac{{Selling Price} - {Cost Price}}{{Cost Price}}) times 100 %

**Calculation:**

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100

Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 40% of 100

⇒ MP = 100 + 40

⇒ MP = 140

Due to faulty machine, the quantity measured is 15% less, hence the quantity sold is 85%

⇒ Selling Price (SP) before discount = 140

Discount given = 32% of 140

⇒ Discount = 32% × 140

⇒ Discount = 0.32 × 140

⇒ Discount = 44.8

SP after discount = 140 - 44.8

⇒ SP = 95.2

Effective quantity sold = 85% of CP = 85% of 100

⇒ Effective quantity sold = 85

Profit/Loss = SP - Effective CP

⇒ Profit/Loss = 95.2 - 85

⇒ Profit = 10.2

Profit percentage = ((10.2)/(85)) times 100 %

⇒ Profit percentage = 12%

**The profit percentage is 12%.**

questions.question: Simplify: 5 + (5 times 5)/(5) - 5
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the operator priority: Division and Multiplication are solved before Addition and Subtraction.

Solve the core fraction: 5 × 5 ÷ 5 = 5 (the multiplication and division by 5 cancel each other out).

The expression simplifies to: 5 + 5 − 5.

Final result: 10 − 5 = 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = 5 + 5 × 5 ÷ 5 − 5

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS Rule (Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ 5 + (25 ÷ 5) − 5
⇒ 5 + 5 − 5
⇒ 10 − 5
⇒ 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It ensures a standard sequence for solving mathematical expressions: Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, then Addition/Subtraction.

Priority of Operations

Multiplication and Division have the same rank and should be solved from left to right as they appear in the expression.

Addition and Subtraction

Similarly, Addition and Subtraction carry equal priority and are calculated from left to right after all other operations are completed.</p

questions.question: The difference between the compound interest (Compounded annually) and simple interest for an amount of Rs. 85,000 in 2 years is Rs. 850. Find the rate of Interest per annum.
questions.solution:

Time (T) = 2 years

Difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest = Rs. 850

**Formula Used:**

Difference = P × (R/100)² when T = 2 years

**Calculation:**

850 = 85000 × (R/100)²

⇒ R² = 100

questions.question: What is the remainder when (1235 × 4523 × 2451) is divided by 12 ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find the individual negative or positive remainders when each term is divided by 12.

1235 ÷ 12 → Remainder is −1 (since 1236 is a multiple of 12)

4523 ÷ 12 → Remainder is −1 (since 4524 is a multiple of 12)

2451 ÷ 12 → Remainder is 3 (since 2448 is a multiple of 12)

Combined Remainder = (−1) × (−1) × 3 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = (1235 × 4523 × 2451) ÷ 12

**Formula Used:**

Remainder of (A × B × C) ÷ N = [Remainder(A ÷ N) × Remainder(B ÷ N) × Remainder(C ÷ N)] ÷ N

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1235 = 102 × 12 + 11 → Remainder = 11

⇒ 4523 = 376 × 12 + 11 → Remainder = 11

⇒ 2451 = 204 × 12 + 3 → Remainder = 3

⇒ Product of remainders = 11 × 11 × 3

⇒ Product of remainders = 121 × 3 = 363

⇒ Now, divide the product by 12 to find the final remainder:

⇒ 363 = 30 × 12 + 3 → Remainder = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Remainder Theorem for Multiplication

The remainder of a product is equal to the product of the remainders of the individual numbers divided by the same divisor. Rule: Remainder of (A × B) ÷ N = [Remainder(A ÷ N) × Remainder(B ÷ N)] ÷ N.

Concept of Negative Remainders

If a number is divided by a divisor 'N' and gives a remainder 'R', it can also be represented as a negative remainder '(R − N)'. This simplifies calculations when the positive remainder is very close to the divisor (e.g., a remainder of 11 when divided by 12 is computationally equivalent to −1).

Divisibility Rule of 12

A number is completely divisible by 12 if it is divisible by both 3 and 4. A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits are divisible by 4, and divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 3.
</p

questions.question: The inner and outer radii of a hemispherical wooden bowl are 6 cm and 8 cm, respectively. Its entire surface has to be polished and the cost of polishing π cm² is Rs. 50. How much will it cost to polish the bowl?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a **hollow hemispherical bowl** = 3πR² + πr²

Given: **Outer radius (R)** = 8 cm and **Inner radius (r)** = 6 cm.

TSA = π(3 × 8² + 6²) = π(192 + 36) = 228π cm².

Cost of polishing π cm² = Rs. 50 ⇒ Total Cost = 228 × 50 = Rs. 11,400.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 11,400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Inner radius (r) = 6 cm

Outer radius (R) = 8 cm

Polishing rate = Rs. 50 per π cm²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2c3a9cf84f6e92bf787a35aac322ab838093c7448d0a6b1b73e8d95de841cff.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area = **Outer CSA** + **Inner CSA** + **Area of the Ring**

TSA = 2πR² + 2πr² + π(R² − r²)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Outer CSA = 2 × π × 8² = 128π cm²

⇒ Inner CSA = 2 × π × 6² = 72π cm²

⇒ Area of Top Ring = π(8² − 6²) = π(64 − 36) = 28π cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area = 128π + 72π + 28π = 228π cm²

⇒ Cost of polishing π cm² = Rs. 50

⇒ Total Polishing Cost = (228π / π) × 50

⇒ Total Polishing Cost = 228 × 50 = Rs. 11,400

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 11,400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Hollow Hemisphere

The volume of the material of a hollow hemispherical bowl is given by V = (2/3)π(R³ − r³), where R is the outer radius and r is the inner radius.

Surface Area of a Solid Hemisphere

For a solid hemisphere of radius R, the total surface area is TSA = 3πR², which includes the curved surface (2πR²) and the flat circular base (πR²).

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a complete sphere is 4πR², and its volume is (4/3)πR³.</p

questions.question: A student has to secure 35% marks to pass. He secured 650 marks and failed by 50 marks. Find the maximum marks.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Passing Marks** required = 650 + 50 = 700

According to the question, 35% of **Maximum Marks** = 700

1% of **Maximum Marks** = 700 ÷ 35 = 20

100% (**Maximum Marks**) = 20 × 100 = 2000

**∴ The correct answer is 2000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Pass percentage** = 35%

**Marks secured** by student = 650

**Failing margin** = 50 marks

**Formula Used:**

**Passing Marks** = **Marks Obtained** + **Marks Failed By**

**Maximum Marks** = (**Passing Marks** ÷ **Pass Percentage**) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec00be1505285ae151f0dbcd8c492ae4f8a7f7fb9f4a588155e0a5ea6947e470.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Passing Marks** = 650 + 50 = 700

⇒ Let the **maximum marks** be M.

⇒ 35% of M = 700

⇒ (35 ÷ 100) × M = 700

⇒ M = (700 × 100) ÷ 35

⇒ M = 20 × 100

⇒ M = 2000

**∴ The correct answer is 2000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Passing Marks Calculation

The **passing marks** are calculated by adding the **failing margin** to the marks obtained, or by subtracting the **excess marks** from the marks obtained if the student passed.

Percentage Base Change

Always identify the **100% base** (Maximum Marks) to solve percentage-related scoring problems using the unitary method.

Fraction Conversion

Converting percentage to fraction can simplify calculations: 35% = 35/100 = 7/20. Here, 7 units = 700, so 20 units = 2000.</p

questions.question: A person walks 4/5 of his usual speed and reaches his office 20 minutes late. Find his original time to reach the office.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio (New : Usual) = 4 : 5 ⇒ Time ratio (New : Usual) = 5 : 4

Difference in time ratio = 5 − 4 = 1 part

Given delay = 1 part = 20 minutes

Original time = 4 parts = 4 × 20 = 80 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 80 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

New speed = 4/5 of usual speed

Late time = 20 minutes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aaa3d2fec5bdb397a19f48a51d5112c3348ece18cc820f53ca298586abe8b9c.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the usual speed be S and usual time be T.

⇒ Since distance is constant, S₁ × T₁ = S₂ × T₂

⇒ S × T = (4/5) × S × (T + 20)

⇒ T = 4/5 × (T + 20)

⇒ 5T = 4T + 80

⇒ 5T − 4T = 80

⇒ T = 80 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 80 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Relation of Speed and Time

When distance is constant, speed and time are inversely proportional. Ratio of speeds = a : b ⇒ Ratio of times = b : a.

Direct Formula for Usual Time

If a person travels at a/b of his usual speed and is late by t minutes, Usual Time = (a ÷ |a − b|) × t.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).
</p

questions.question: The downstream speed for the boat is 100 kmph and the upstream speed is 75% of the downstream speed. Find the time taken by the boat to travel 350 km in still water.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Downstream speed** (D) = 100 kmph

**Upstream speed** (U) = 75% of 100 = 75 kmph

**Speed in still water** = (D + U) ÷ 2 = (100 + 75) ÷ 2 = 87.5 kmph

**Required Time** = Distance ÷ Still water speed = 350 ÷ 87.5 = 4 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 4 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Downstream speed = 100 kmph

Upstream speed = 75% of Downstream speed

Distance to travel = 350 km

**Formula Used:**

Speed in Still Water (u) = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed) ÷ 2

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95ce33c10148ff0e43de4012026b92dfdc4872af4f90471927a658edb6338da9.png] 

⇒ **Upstream speed** = (75 ÷ 100) × 100 = 75 kmph

⇒ **Speed of boat in still water** = (100 + 75) ÷ 2

⇒ **Speed of boat in still water** = 175 ÷ 2 = 87.5 kmph

⇒ **Time taken** = 350 ÷ 87.5

⇒ **Time taken** = 4 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 4 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Stream

The speed of the current or stream (v) is calculated as half the difference between downstream and upstream speeds: v = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Downstream and Upstream

Downstream speed = Speed of boat + Speed of stream. Upstream speed = Speed of boat − Speed of stream.

Average Speed of Boat

When a boat travels the same distance downstream and upstream, the average speed is given by (D × U) ÷ Still water speed, which is also (u² − v²) ÷ u.</p

questions.question: If the radius of a cylinder is decreased by 40% and the height is increased by 60% to form a new cylinder, then the volume will be decreased by
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a cylinder is decreased by 40%

The height is increased by 60% to form a new cylinder.

**Concept used:**

If the radius is contested then the volume of the cylinder is directly proportional to height.

If the height is contested then the volume of the cylinder is directly proportional to radius.

**Formula used:**

volume of the cylinder = π × (radius)² × height

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of cylinder be r cm and height be h cm.

Then, volume of the cylinder is

⇒ π × (radius)2 × height

⇒ πr²h cm³

Now, increment in height = 60%

⇒ h × (160/100)

⇒ 8h/5 cm

Radius after decreasing 40%

⇒ r × (60/100)

⇒ 3r/5 cm

Now, the volume of the cylinder

⇒ π × (radius)² × height

⇒ π × (3r/5)² × (8h/5)

⇒ π × (9r²/25) × 8h/5

⇒ (72πr²h/125) cm³

Now, the difference between both volumes

⇒ (πr²h) – (72πr2h/125) cm³

⇒ (125πr²h – 72πr²h)/125 cm³

⇒ 53πr²h/125 cm³

Now,

The volume will be decreased by

⇒ [(53πr2h/125)/πr²h × 100]

⇒ (53/125 × 100)

⇒ 212/5

⇒ 42.4%

**∴ The volume will be decreased by 42.4%**

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of father and son is 60 years. Five years ago, the age of the father was four times that of the son, then what will be the age of the son now?
questions.solution:
Given:

The sum of the present ages of father and son is 60 years. 

Five years ago, the age of the father was four times that of the son.

Calculation:

Let the present of the father and son be P and Q respectively.

According to the question,

P + Q = 60

⇒ P = 60 - Q ....(1)

(P - 5) = 4 × (Q - 5)

⇒ 60 - Q - 5 = 4Q - 20 (From 1)

⇒ 5Q = 55 + 20

⇒ Q = 75/5

⇒ Q = 15

∴ The present age of the son is 15 years.

questions.question: By selling goods for ₹15,000, Ramu gains ₹3,000. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given values:**

Selling price = ₹15,000

Profit = ₹3,000

**Concept: **Profit percent = (Profit / Cost Price) x 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Cost Price = Selling Price - Profit = ₹15,000 - ₹3,000 = ₹12,000

⇒ Profit percentage = (₹3,000 / ₹12,000) x 100

**Hence, his profit percentage is 25%.**

questions.question: Chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P. If CD = 11.6 cm, PD = 6.4 cm and PB = 7.2 cm, then AB (in cm) is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P.

CD = 11.6 cm

PD = 6.4 cm

PB = 7.2 cm

**Concept used:**

Using basic proportionality theorem,

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24526f6530eed7c3e8e36c4f5f9667337595d824f31cbc64b09ccc6379e27375.png] 

Let the value of AB be x 

Then, PA = PB + AB

⇒ PA = (7.2 + x) cm

Again,

PC = PD + CD

⇒ PC = (6.4 + 11.6) = 18 cm

Now,

Using basic proportionality theorem,

PB × PA = PD × PC

⇒ 7.2 × (7.2 + x) = 6.4 × 18

⇒ 51.84 + 7.2x = 115.2

⇒ 7.2x = (115.2 – 51.84)

⇒ 7.2x = 63.36

⇒ x = (63.36/7.2)

⇒ x = 8.8 cm

**∴ The required value of AB is 8.8 cm**
